scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional salmon palette and clean pill-button controls show design care, but the visualization is clipped at the bottom, the dual-accent UI (blue active state + green button) lacks color system coherence, and heavy dark edge bundles over the circles create visual noise without clear payoff.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for area encoding, data-driven domains via d3.extent, and key functions on node/link joins ensure honest encoding; hierarchy-link join omits a key function but causes no quantitative distortion in this relational layout.
scores.stress_test_note: The tension-slider fires redrawLinks() (300 paths) on every input event with no RAF/debounce coalescing, layout transitions lack explicit .interrupt() calls before new ones start, and drag/hover handlers omit event.sourceEvent touch-vs-mouse filtering.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack hierarchy reads clearly but 300 bundled connections between 200 leaf nodes collapse into a central hairball that obliterates the edge layer — structure is visible, relationships are not.
